title: Mornington Tourist Railway – School Holiday Special Runs
summary: Heritage steam and diesel train rides at Mornington Tourist Railway. Special runs during school holidays and on select Sundays. 5km scenic journey between Moorooduc and Mornington. Vintage carriages. Kids and train enthusiasts of all ages. Moorooduc Station is also adjacent to the Moorooduc Station
